parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance.

parameters.name: SourceTableName
parameters.description: The name of the table that you want to convert or shard.

parameters.name: TargetTableName
parameters.description: The name of the table that is generated after you convert or shard the table.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds describe-shard-task-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drds-instance-id drds000000000 --db-name jjjjjj_ppppp --source-table-name a1 --target-table-name a2 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds DescribeShardTaskInfo --region cn-hangzhou --SourceTableName a1 --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000 --DbName jjjjjj_ppppp --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TargetTableName a2
